record.name: Sudan
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A government account dated 5 November 2025 describes the Sudanese Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority as responsible for national data management and AI use for decision support and public services.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English searches did not identify a qualifying institute. The attributed SUNA report preserved on allAfrica records the creation of a Sudanese Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority under the digital ministry; the report does not describe a technical model-testing remit. The original SUNA page returned 403; the attributed republication remains secondary and does not substitute for the decree text. Confidence remains low and the mandate is flagged for review. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.
Arabic and English status review with newly retrieved government governance accounts and later bill-preparation announcement; not a full record recheck.

check.language_note: The recorded ar queries use a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. The earlier English-search pass on 17 October 2026 left the then-recorded national or official-language coverage unchanged; the work is described below. English queries are not relied on for the national-language requirement in this check; the recorded Arabic queries provide that coverage. The English flag is a coverage decision, not a new adjudication of working-language status. The additional status review used Arabic and English searches and retrieved substantive Arabic government accounts; no primary English translation was found. Query source_ids in the additional status review record registered URLs matched in their shared result batch, not attribution to an individual query. Search batches for the additional status review, using 1-based positions in check.searches: 5, 6, 7; 8, 9, 10; 11, 12. Each group records the same exact registered URLs found in its combined search results, without attribution to an individual query. Explicit page opens and finds and unverified URL variants are excluded. Groups list the recorded queries; some requests also contained additional queries retained in the research evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: Arabic primary accounts on the National Information Centre and Justice Ministry websites establish the authority's broad data/public-service role and later preparation of a data and AI regulation bill. No qualifying model-evaluation institute was identified. The decree and bill texts remain unavailable; medium confidence reflects the recorded Arabic and English check, not proof of absence.

related_bodies.name: Sudanese Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority
related_bodies.role: The National Information Centre's government account says a prime-ministerial decision dated 5 November 2025 created the authority under the digital ministry as an evolution of the centre, covering national data management, governance and AI use for decision support and public services. The detailed statute and a qualifying remit to evaluate advanced models remain unverified.

record.notes: The National Information Centre's own government website carries a substantive Arabic account of the prime-ministerial decision dated 5 November 2025. It describes the Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority as an evolution of the centre, responsible for data management, governance and AI use for decision support and public services. This supplies primary governance evidence beyond the earlier SUNA-attributed French republication. On 10 August 2026 the Ministry of Justice reported that it had prepared, with the digital ministry, a draft data and AI regulation bill for 2026. Neither retrieved account establishes a national institute to evaluate advanced models. Arabic and English searches found no later qualifying act. The original decree and full 2026 bill were not found, so this remains a bounded negative at medium confidence rather than a verified statement of absence.

next_check.reason: Obtain the authority's decree and 2026 data and AI bill to check for a national remit to evaluate advanced models.

sources.title: Soudan: Le pays crée trois organismes nationaux pour la transformation numérique

excerpts.text: Le Premier ministre, le Dr Kamil Idris, a promulgué aujourd'hui un décret pour la création de trois nouveaux organismes nationaux placés sous la tutelle du ministère de la Transformation numérique et des Communications.
excerpts.gloss: Prime Minister Dr Kamil Idris issued a decree today creating three new national bodies under the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications.

excerpts.text: Les nouveaux organismes sont l'Autorité de la transformation numérique, l'Autorité soudanaise des données et de l'intelligence artificielle et l'Autorité soudanaise de la cybersécurité.
excerpts.gloss: The new bodies are the Digital Transformation Authority, the Sudanese Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority, and the Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority.
